# Samuele Bovo

**Animal Genetics · Bioinformatics · Computational Biology**

Assistant Professor in Animal Genetics  
University of Bologna, Italy

**Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions (MSCA) Postdoctoral Global Fellow — ABPhenomics**

My background is in bioinformatics and systems biology, including computational methods for molecular interaction networks and omics data integration.

My research spans animal genetics and genomics, from the genetic architecture of complex traits and pig metabolomics and phenomics to population genomics, biodiversity and molecular traceability.

Depending on the research question, I develop computational methods, integrate omics datasets, or apply statistical and machine learning approaches to biological data.
